Accuracy class      OIML R 76 (III) or (IIII)
Weighing range(s) Single interval
Maximum number of scale intervals n ≤ 3000 divisions
Load cell excitation voltage 5 V DC
Minimum input voltage per verification scale interval 3,3 µV
Minimum load cell resistance 40 Ω

Maximum value of the cable length per cross wire section between the indicator and the junction box or load cells 1,4 m/mm²

Temperature range 0 °C / +40 °C
Power supply voltage 230 V AC 50/60 Hz
9 V DC
Software identification Main processor firmware 1 0923
PIC-processor firmware 1 0820
